lessons: Production wiring is present in merge.py, and test_daemon_composition.py now drives the real __main__ run path. Keep both. The review failed only because tests/test_mergequeue.py got one assertion swap and no new tests. The same gap happened on the previous attempt.

Ignore the earlier lesson that merge_queue must be required. The ticket now requires the trailing merge_queue=None default. Add a test showing Pipeline(stages, merge) gives merge_queue None and compose_pipeline gives a MergeQueue.

In tests/test_mergequeue.py, assert that compose_pipeline(...).merge_queue is the capturing subtype, that its timeout equals drain.max_ticket_minutes*60, and that its env excludes the provider auth variables.

Add real-git adapter tests that call pipeline.merge_queue.admit(candidate). On the green path, check that the squash trailer carries the reviewed SHA. On the red path, a failing ## Verification command must leave no squash commit.
Add approval tests: a fresh pin integrates after main moves; a stale pin or missing review.md is refused without squash; an up-to-date rebase with ORIG_HEAD deleted or stale still integrates.
For each outcome (success, refusal, raised exception, cancelled admit task), assert the admission_state dict passed to compose_merge_queue is empty afterwards.

Before relying on integrate raising ValueError when approval changes, read how mergequeue.py handles an exception from integrate. Test that it leaves no squash and a clean unwind. Do not report Outcome ok until every acceptance criterion has a test.
